__broaden__.ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行)) · also the final -n of the past participle -dügsen carried over in print, with Shiratori's (i), the token left before the reflexive -jen (öisüledügse- n(i)-jen, 'my own having harmed'; participle remnant; the Ming 陰害了的 stands on öisüledügse-, and the 自的行 of n(i)-jen belongs to -jen)
__broaden__.jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word') · also after ösül(i)- ('one's own enmity'), ebür(i)- ('one's own bosom'), čeriġüd(i)- ('one's own troops') and deġel(i)- ('one's own robe') · also after üges-tür(i)- ('in one's own words'), nököd(i)- ('one's own companions'), helige-ber(i)- ('prone, lying', analysis uncertain) and plain tür(i)- ('in one's own') · also after čerig(i)- ('one's own troops') and eje-dür(i)- ('in one's own counsel', eje uncertain), the token left being jen · also after geġüd(i)- ('one's own mares', stem uncertain) and öġer(i)- ('one's own self', Ming 自己 自), the token left being jen · also after sedkil(i)- ('one's own heart'), sedkigsen(i)- ('what one has thought') and žüġegseġer(i)- ('those one has set in place'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after ger(i)- ('one's own home', Ming 家 自的行) and kököd(i)- ('one's own breasts', plural, Ming 乳每 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after žereg(i)- ('one's own requirements', Ming 需 自的行) and after the participle remnant n(i)- (öisüledügse- n(i)-jen, 'one's own having harmed'), where the (i) is Shiratori's
